package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "strings"
    "testing"
    "time"

    "github.com/Lore-Hex/quill-cloud-proxy/enclave-go/internal/llm"
    "github.com/Lore-Hex/quill-cloud-proxy/enclave-go/internal/trustedrouter"
    "github.com/Lore-Hex/quill-cloud-proxy/enclave-go/internal/types"
)

func TestP4aProbeHandoffs(t *testing.T) {
    t.Setenv("QUILL_USAGE_HEARTBEAT", "off")
    t.Setenv("QUILL_TERMINATE_AT_CAP", "off")
    t.Setenv("TR_ASYNC_SETTLE_NEGOTIATE", "off")
    trustedrouter.ShadowBuildRevision = strings.Repeat("a", 40)
    for _, adapter := range []string{"openai", "anthropic"} {
        for _, route := range []string{"chat.completions", "responses"} {
            for _, streamed := range []bool{false, true} {
                name := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%v", adapter, route, streamed)
                t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
                    reply, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("P4A_INPUT"), name+".json"))
                    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                    var data struct { Data struct { Model string `json:"model"` } `json:"data"` }
                    if err := json.Unmarshal(reply, &data); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                    var baseline string
                    for _, enabled := range []bool{false, true} {
                        flag := "off"
                        if enabled { flag = "on" }
                        t.Setenv("TR_ASYNC_SETTLE_SHADOW", flag)
                        var body, header, path string
                        terminals := 0
                        transport := shadowV2StreamTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
                            answer := string(reply)
                            if r.URL.Path != "/internal/gateway/authorize" {
                                terminals++
                                raw, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
                                body, header, path = string(raw), r.Header.Get("X-TR-Settlement-Shadow"), r.URL.Path
                                answer = `{"data":{"settled":true,"cost_microdollars":4,"generation_id":"test"}}`
                            }
                            return &http.Response{StatusCode:200, Header:make(http.Header), Body:io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(answer))}, nil
                        })
                        gateway := trustedrouter.New("https://trustedrouter.com", "test", &http.Client{Transport:transport})
                        limit := 2
                        req := &types.OpenAIChatRequest{Model:data.Data.Model, Stream:streamed, MaxTokens:&limit, RequestedParameters:[]string{"max_tokens"}, StreamOptions:&types.ChatStreamOptions{IncludeUsage:true}}
                        auth, err := gateway.AuthorizeWithRoute(t.Context(), "key", req, route)
                        if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                        var output bytes.Buffer
                        if streamed {
                            serveStreaming(t.Context(), &output, shadowStreamProvider{}, req, &types.AnthropicMessagesRequest{},
                                []llm.InvokeOptions{{Model:auth.Model, Provider:auth.Provider, EndpointID:auth.EndpointID}},
                                gateway, auth, nil, time.Now(), nil, route, "p4a", auth.Model)
                        } else {
                            usage := trustedrouter.Usage{InputTokens:1, OutputTokens:1, ElapsedSeconds:1, RouteType:route, SelectedModel:auth.Model,
                                SelectedEndpoint:auth.EndpointID, ShadowObservation:trustedrouter.ObserveShadowUsage(true, "")}
                            auth.RecordShadowInvocation(auth.EndpointID, auth.Provider)
                            if _, err := gateway.Settle(t.Context(), auth, usage); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                        }
                        if terminals != 1 { t.Fatalf("terminal count %d", terminals) }
                        transcript := normalizeShadowClocks(output.String())+"\n"+normalizeShadowClocks(body)
                        if !enabled {
                            baseline = transcript
                            if header != "" { t.Fatal("off header") }
                        } else {
                            if transcript != baseline { t.Fatal("stream/body differential") }
                            if header == "" { t.Fatal("missing compared header") }
                            raw, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"header":header, "body":json.RawMessage(body),
                                "path":path, "stream":normalizeShadowClocks(output.String()), "off_on_bytes_equal":true})
                            if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                            if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("P4A_OUTPUT"), name+".json"), raw, 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                        }
                    }
                })
            }
        }
    }
}
